detail.text: I need to read the repository structure and AGENTS.md first, then create a plan for building the link shortener application.

Now I have a good understanding of the repository structure. Let me create the plan for building the link shortener application.

Based on the issue spec and AGENTS.md, I need to plan cards that:
1. Foundation: Set up database schema, store interface, auth/session infrastructure, and one end-to-end test
2. Feature cards for accounts (signup/login/logout), links CRUD, redirect/stats, QR code, rate limiting
3. Frontend pages
4. Integration: acceptance tests

Let me structure this into cards following the constraints (each card adds routes in its own `internal/server/routes_<key>.go`, max 10 files per card, 2-12 cards total).

```json
{
  "summary": "Build a link shortener with Go API and React frontend. Foundation card establishes SQLite store interface, session/auth middleware, migrations and server constructor. Feature cards add accounts, links, redirect/stats, QR code and rate limiting APIs plus their frontend pages. Integration card wires acceptance tests A1-A9.",
  "cards": [
    {
      "key": "foundation",
      "role": "foundation",
      "title": "Store, sessions, migrations and server skeleton",
      "brief": "Set up the app's contracts every other card builds on. Create `internal/store.Store` interface with methods stubbed: CreateUser, GetUserByEmail, CreateSession, GetSession, DeleteSession, CreateLink, ListLinksByUser, GetLinkBySlug, DeleteLink, RecordClick, GetClickStats. Implementation in `internal/sqlite` using modernc.org/sqlite at $DATA_DIR/links.db. Add migration `migrations/20261001000000_init.sql` creating users, sessions, links, clicks tables. Add `internal/session` package with HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie helpers and `UserID(r *http.Request) (string, bool)` to extract logged-in user from context. Update `server.New` to open the store, run migrations, and pass store+session through request context via middleware. One end-to-end test in `internal/server/server_test.go`: POST /api/signup creates user, GET /healthz still works. Handlers get user via `session.UserID(r)`. Store is `store.Store` interface; implementation is `sqlite.New(dataDir)`.",
      "directories": ["internal/store", "internal/sqlite", "internal/session", "migrations", "internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestServerHealthz in internal/server: GET /healthz returns 200 {status:ok}"],
      "size": "medium"
    },
    {
      "key": "accounts",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Sign up, log in, log out and /api/me endpoints",
      "brief": "Implement account endpoints in `internal/server/routes_accounts.go`: POST /api/signup (email + password >=10 chars, bcrypt hash, returns user JSON), POST /api/login (sets session cookie), POST /api/logout (deletes session), GET /api/me (returns current user or 401). Use `session.UserID(r)` for auth checks. Validate email format and password length; return 400 on invalid input, 409 on duplicate email. Unit tests in `internal/server/routes_accounts_test.go` cover signup, login sets cookie, logout clears it, /api/me returns user when authenticated and 401 otherwise.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": [],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignupLoginLogout in internal/server: signup then login sets cookie, /api/me returns email, logout then /api/me returns 401"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "links-api",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Create, list and delete link endpoints",
      "brief": "Implement link management in `internal/server/routes_links.go`: POST /api/links (URL must be http/https <=2048 chars, optional custom slug [a-z0-9-]{3,32}, else 7 random chars; 409 if slug taken; requires auth), GET /api/links (list user's links with click counts), DELETE /api/links/<slug> (only owner, else 404). Slug generation uses crypto/rand. Tests verify URL validation rejects ftp scheme with 400, custom slug collision returns 409, second user cannot delete first user's link (404) and link still redirects.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": ["accounts"],
      "acceptance": ["TestCreateLink in internal/server: POST /api/links with valid URL returns slug", "TestDeleteOtherUserLink in internal/server: DELETE by non-owner returns 404, link still exists"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "redirect-stats",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Redirect handler and per-link stats endpoint",
      "brief": "Add redirect and stats in `internal/server/routes_redirect.go`: GET /<slug> answers 302 to target URL and records click (total + per UTC day); unknown slug answers 404. GET /api/links/<slug>/stats returns clicks per day for last 30 days (requires auth, owner only). Click recording increments daily counter atomically. Stats response is array of {date, count} for each of last 30 days. Tests verify redirect sets Location header, increments count, and stats show today's count after two redirects.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": ["links-api"],
      "acceptance": ["TestRedirect in internal/server: GET /<slug> returns 302 with Location header", "TestStats in internal/server: after 2 redirects, stats shows today count=2 and 30 entries"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "qr-code",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "QR code PNG endpoint for short URLs",
      "brief": "Add QR endpoint in `internal/server/routes_qr.go`: GET /api/links/<slug>/qr generates PNG of short URL (scheme+host+slug) using a pure-Go QR library (e.g. github.com/skip2/go-qrcode). Returns image/png content type. Requires auth, owner only; unknown slug 404. Test verifies response Content-Type is image/png and body decodes as valid PNG (check PNG signature bytes).",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": ["links-api"],
      "acceptance": ["TestQRCode in internal/server: GET /api/links/<slug>/qr returns 200 image/png with valid PNG header"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "rate-limits",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Rate limiting for auth and link creation",
      "brief": "Add rate limiting in `internal/server/routes_ratelimit.go`: in-memory sliding window counters keyed by client IP for signup/login (10/min) and by user ID for link creation (30/hour). Middleware checks before handlers; returns 429 when exceeded. Use sync.Mutex + map with periodic cleanup. Tests simulate 11 login attempts within a minute and verify the 11th returns 429.",
      "directories": ["internal/server"],
      "depends_on": ["accounts", "links-api"],
      "acceptance": ["TestRateLimitLogin in internal/server: 11th login attempt in same minute returns 429"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "frontend-auth",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Sign up, log in pages and auth state",
      "brief": "Add React pages in `web/src/pages/`: SignUp.tsx (form with email/password, calls POST /api/signup, redirects to /app/links on success), Login.tsx (form calls POST /api/login, redirects on success). Add AuthContext in `web/src/auth.tsx` providing user state and logout function via GET /api/me on mount. Update App.tsx routes to include /signup, /login. Protected route wrapper redirects to /login if unauthenticated. Tests use mockFetch and renderAt to verify forms render and submit correctly.",
      "directories": ["web/src/pages", "web/src"],
      "depends_on": ["accounts"],
      "acceptance": ["TestSignUpPage in web/src: renders email and password fields", "TestLoginPage in web/src: renders and submits credentials"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "frontend-links",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "My links page with create, list, copy and delete",
      "brief": "Add Links.tsx page in `web/src/pages/`: shows form to create link (URL input, optional slug), lists user's links with click counts, copy button copies short URL to clipboard, delete button calls DELETE /api/links/<slug>. Uses fetch to GET /api/links and POST /api/links. Add route /app/links in App.tsx. Tests verify list renders link items with counts and delete button triggers API call via mockFetch.",
      "directories": ["web/src/pages", "web/src"],
      "depends_on": ["frontend-auth", "links-api"],
      "acceptance": ["TestLinksPage in web/src: renders link list with click counts", "TestCreateLinkForm in web/src: submits URL and shows new link"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "frontend-detail",
      "role": "feature",
      "title": "Link detail page with stats chart and QR code",
      "brief": "Add LinkDetail.tsx in `web/src/pages/`: fetches GET /api/links/<slug>/stats and GET /api/links/<slug>/qr. Displays bar chart (one bar per day for 30 days, height proportional to count) using inline SVG or simple CSS bars. Shows QR code image. Route /app/links/:slug in App.tsx. NotFound.tsx page for unmatched routes. Tests verify stats bars render and QR image loads via mockFetch.",
      "directories": ["web/src/pages", "web/src"],
      "depends_on": ["frontend-links", "redirect-stats", "qr-code"],
      "acceptance": ["TestLinkDetailPage in web/src: renders 30 stat bars and QR image"],
      "size": "small"
    },
    {
      "key": "integration",
      "role": "integration",
      "title": "Acceptance tests A1 through A9",
      "brief": "Create acceptance tests in `acceptance/acceptance_test.go` against `server.New` via httptest. A1: signup, login, GET /api/me returns user, logout, /api/me returns 401. A2: create link, GET /<slug> returns 302 with Location, list shows 1 click. A3: duplicate custom slug returns 409, ftp URL returns 400. A4: second user deleting first user's link returns 404, link still redirects. A5: stats returns 30 days, today count=2 after two redirects. A6: QR endpoint returns image/png decodable as PNG. A7: 11th login in a minute returns 429. A8: GET /app/ and /app/links/abc return index with <div id=\"root\">. A9: GET /nope123 returns 404. All tests run under `go test ./...` and `bash check`.",
      "directories": ["acceptance"],
      "depends_on": ["accounts", "links-api", "redirect-stats", "qr-code", "rate-limits", "frontend-auth", "frontend-links", "frontend-detail"],
      "acceptance": ["TestA1SignupLoginMeLogout in acceptance: full auth flow", "TestA2CreateRedirectList in acceptance: link creation and redirect counting", "TestA3SlugConflictBadScheme in acceptance: 409 and 400 cases", "TestA4CrossUserDelete in acceptance: non-owner delete returns 404", "TestA5StatsThirtyDays in acceptance: 30-day stats with counts", "TestA6QRPng in acceptance: valid PNG response", "TestA7RateLimit in acceptance: 429 on 11th attempt", "TestA8AppPages in acceptance: SPA fallback serves index", "TestA9UnknownSlug in acceptance: 404 for missing slug"],
      "size": "medium"
    }
  ]
}
```
